116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in $N.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in $N or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-complete.text:
By the Light!  The Stormwind Army retreated from $N.  And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire?  There is some treachery abound.  How could this be so? 

Oh I forgot to reward your service, $c.  Here are some coins.  Now excuse me.  Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.
146-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

1716-accept.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1716-accept.text:
A sayaad is a devourer of souls, dominator of wills, and tempter of hearts. It knows nothing but evil.

Salacious tales refer to the demon by its common name: succubus for females, incubus for males.

A stimulus is required to beckon the creature. With a symbol of love as bait, it will surely answer your call. Defeat it, and make it your tool.

It will be hard to find a thing of this nature, though. You should speak with Takar the Seer. You will find him in the Barrens of Kalimdor near Camp Taurajo.
1716-accept.title: Devourer of Souls
